one_sentence_story: By mapping 126 awake neurosurgical patients with numbered paper tickets in Montreal in 1937, Wilder Penfield and Edwin Boldrey revealed the Cortical Homunculus — proving hands and speech organs dominate human sensorimotor cortex, a map updated in 2023 with interleaved mind-body planning hubs.
so_what_for_you: Use your giant cortical hand-and-speech real estate intentionally: writing notes by hand, sketching diagrams, and explaining ideas aloud recruit massive sensorimotor cortical territory compared with passive scrolling.
